notablePrerequisites: You have at least one experience counter.
description:
Activate Daxos by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit enchantment creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus and Spirit, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Farrelite Priest by paying {1}, adding {W}.
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Repeat.
